title_sq: Shitet 2+1 + Parkim te Liqeni i Thate!
description_sq:
Liqeni i Thate eshte zone shume e kerkuar si per banim dhe per investim, duke qene se ka cdo sherbim dhe lehtesi qe i nevojitet perditshmerise. Gjithashtu ka akses te menjehershem me Unazen e madhe, e cila lidhet me zonat kryesore te Tiranes.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje ndertim te vitit 2025, ne krah te Radisonit. Pozicionohet ne katin e 4 te pallatit dhe ka siperfaqe totale 118m². Organizohet si 2+1 me dy tualete dhe 3 ballkone. Orientimi Jug. Jane bere punime shtese ne instalime hidraulike & elektrike, vetrata me dopio xham dhe grila elektrike, sistem kapot etj.
Shitet si ne foto dhe eshte gati per t'u mobiluar. Ne cmim perfshihet dhe nje post parkimi.
Per me teper informacion apo nje vizite ne prone ju ftoj te kontaktoni!
title_en: For sale 2+1 + Parking at Liqeni i Thate!
description_en: Lake Thate is a highly sought-after area for both residence and investment, as it has every service and convenience needed for everyday life. It also has immediate access to the Great Ring, which connects to the main areas of Tirana. The apartment is located in a building of 2025, next to Radisson. It is located on the 4th floor of the building and has a total area of ​​118m². It is organized as 2+1 with two toilets and 3 balconies. Orientation South. Additional works have been done on hydraulic and electrical installations, double-glazed windows and electric shutters, bonnet system, etc. It is sold as in the photo and is ready to be furnished. The price includes a parking post. For more information or a visit to the property, I invite you to contact me!
